component.name: PlanMeter
component.summary: See what your AI coding agents cost

description.p: PlanMeter shows spend, tokens, cache savings, and Codex rate limits for your Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode accounts, split into Personal and Work plans.

ul.li: Totals for the last hour, today, or the last 24 hours, 7, 30, or 90 days
A stacked timeline per account, down to one-minute buckets
Spend limits, with a notification as you approach and reach them
Usage by model, and Codex rate-limit windows with reset times
Pair a phone over Tailscale to check usage away from your desk

description.p: The app reads its numbers from planmeterd, the PlanMeter background service, which scans transcripts on this computer. Prompts and transcripts never leave it.
The first Linux desktop version: a dashboard, remote pairing, and spend alerts.
